title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - ActuatorSwitch
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/ActuatorSwitch. Basic on/off operations on a simple actuator can be modelled with the ActuatorSwitch class. Whether the function turns a device itself ON or OFF, or whether it switches a specific feature, depends on the implementation. For example, one could model the super freeze program of a freezer using ActuatorSwitch class. An ON command would then activate the super freeze program and an OFF command would deactivate it. This example shall just give an idea how ActuatorSwitch can be used for more purposes than only turning devices on and off. Subclass of Actuator (https://saref.etsi.org/core/Actuator, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ActuatorSwitch'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
